external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of the three insurance partners that provides a daily extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: Each partner has a static key issued during onboarding.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.
external_entities.notes: Analysts authenticate with SSO and have a dataset-wide grant; member-identifying columns have not been separated.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that runs nightly, lists and reads files from the landing bucket, and triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A transform job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: The transform normalizes records. Nothing validates row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket receiving daily extract files from the insurance partners.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The source states: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted" and says both stores are on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database, containing connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source states: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest" and says both stores are on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse containing normalized claim records queried by analysts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: Analysts query the warehouse directly and have a dataset-wide grant; member-identifying columns have not been separated.
